2609.34242.title: Stashbird: Efficient Speaker-Indexed Memory for Conversational Agents
2609.34242.paper_summary: AI agents require memory that preserves information across user-agent exchanges, user-to-user conversations, and group conversations with or without agent participation, while supporting updates as evidence changes or is removed. We present Stashbird, an agent memory system that links source episodes to derived memory state through explicit provenance. Stashbird organizes memory into episodic records, semantic relations, community summaries, and persisted graph state, with lifecycle operations for incremental updates and episode-level deletion. We evaluate question-answering accuracy and model-facing workload across four long-term memory benchmarks. On LoCoMo, Stashbird uses 76.4x fewer ingestion prompt tokens than Graphiti. Compared with reproduced Hindsight on the same benchmark, it uses 8.1x fewer retrieval prompt tokens, with accuracy 1.6 percentage points lower. It achieves higher accuracy than Hindsight on LongMemEval-S and GroupMemBench and comparable accuracy on EverMemBench.
2609.34242.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理需要記憶，以保持在用戶與代理之間的交流、用戶之間的對話，以及有或沒有代理參與的群組對話中的信息，同時支持隨著證據的變化或移除而進行更新。<lb/>我們提出了 Stashbird，一個代理記憶系統，通過明確的來源關係將源事件鏈接到衍生的記憶狀態。<lb/>Stashbird 將記憶組織為情節記錄、語義關係、社區摘要和持久圖狀態，並提供增量更新和事件級刪除的生命周期操作。<lb/>我們在四個長期記憶基準上評估了問題回答的準確性和模型面對的工作負載。<lb/>在 LoCoMo 上，Stashbird 使用的攝取提示令牌比 Graphiti 少 76.4 倍。<lb/>與在同一基準上重現的 Hindsight 相比，它使用的檢索提示令牌少 8.1 倍，準確性低 1.6 個百分點。<lb/>在 LongMemEval-S 和 GroupMemBench 上，它的準確性高於 Hindsight，而在 EverMemBench 上的準確性則相當。
